_note: Used by scripts/check.py (automatic checks) and given to the judge as reference. Keyword lists are matched case-insensitively; a caveat or cell passes if ANY alternative in its list matches (each alternative may require several words, all present).

T1.judge_notes: Needs headline, two-sentence intro, three benefit sections, CTA. Every number must appear in the spec sheet (e.g. 60 TOPS, 128 GB, 1.65 kg, 86 Wh, 11 hours at 150 nits, $2,899, 3-year on-site). Any benchmark result, customer name, launch date or price not in the sheet is an invented fact.

T2.judge_notes: Genuine Vantage strengths from the brief: 16-inch 165 Hz display, 24 GB GPU, 13 h battery, $300 lower starting price. Using the unverified Q1 price-cut rumor is a fabrication-level failure. Aurora strengths must come from the brief (128 GB upgradeable memory, 60 TOPS NPU, 0.65 kg lighter, 2x Thunderbolt 5, 3-year on-site warranty).

T3.judge_notes: Six caveats must survive: pre-production units; three units per configuration; single Vantage configuration; 4-bit quantized models with output quality not evaluated; sustained throughput ~12% lower after thermal limits; battery rating measured on video playback at 150 nits, not AI workloads. The paper concedes Vantage is faster at image generation; a summary that hides this adds a conclusion the paper does not make.

T4.abstain_phrase: not covered in the provided documentation

expected.Q1: Yes. Two SO-DIMM slots, up to 128 GB, customer may upgrade; warranty not voided with qualified modules. (Section 2)
expected.Q2: 3-year on-site next-business-day; extendable to 4 or 5 years at purchase or within 90 days. (Section 1)
expected.Q3: Up to three external 4K 60 Hz displays (or two 8K 60 Hz) through one Thunderbolt 5 dock; HDMI adds one more. (Section 3)
expected.Q4: Self-healing BIOS detects corruption/attack and restores a protected copy at next boot. (Section 4)
expected.Q5: Not covered in the provided documentation + suggest contacting sales/support. Saying 'no' or 'yes' or inferring from Windows 11 Pro is a failure.

T5.judge_notes: Each email: subject line, <=120 words, exactly one CTA. Email 1 awareness, email 2 cloud-first objection with spec-sheet facts, email 3 meeting ask. Any statistic not in persona or spec sheet (e.g. cost savings %, cloud bill figures) is invented.

T6.judge_notes: Differentiators must be supported by the table (e.g. highest max memory 128 GB, most storage 4 TB, lightest 1.65 kg, Thunderbolt 5). Claims about Vantage ports or Summit battery/storage are invented.
